DESCRIPTION:THE INSTITUTE FOR TRIBAL ENVIRONMENTAL PROFESSIONALS AT NORTHERN ARIZONA UNIVERSITY WILL WORK IN COLLABORATION WITH U.S.EPA TO PROVIDE TRIBAL ENVIRONMENTAL PROFESSIONALS WITH OUTSTANDING AIR QUALITY WORKSHOPS AND TECHNICAL SUPPORT, AND OUTREACH PROGRAMS FOR TRIBAL GOVERNMENTS AND AMERICAN INDIAN STUDENTS PURSUING ENVIRONMENTAL CAREERS IN THE FIELD OF AIR QUALITY.ACTIVITIES:1. AIAQTP WORKSHOPS, 2. TAMS CENTER, 3. PROFESSIONAL ASSISTANCE, 4. TRIBAL ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION, OUTREACH AND SUPPORT PROGRAM, 5. ENVIRONMENTAL EDUCATION INTERNSHIP PROGRAM

1. AIAQTP WORKSHOPS - ITEP PROPOSES TO OFFER 15 OR MORE WORKSHOPS IN EACH YEAR OF THIS PROJECT. TEN WORKSHOPS WILL BE IN-PERSON (WITH 8 LOCATED AT THE TAMS CENTER).  WORKSHOPS WILL BE A COMBINATION OF IN-PERSON WORKSHOPS, ON-LINE WORKSHOPS, AND SPECIALTY COURSES DEPENDING ON AVAILABILITY OF FUNDS.   SPECIALTY COURSES ENABLE ITEP TO RESPOND TO PROFESSIONAL DEVELOPMENT REQUESTS BY MULTIPLE TRIBES IN A SPECIFIC GEOGRAPHIC REGION. LIKE OTHER SPECIAL REQUESTS FOR ASSISTANCE, ITEP WILL UTILIZE ESTABLISHED PROTOCOLS TO DOCUMENT AND APPROVE EACH REQUEST, BASED ON THE AVAILABILITY OF STAFF TIME, TECHNICAL COLLABORATORS, AND FINANCIAL RESOURCES. 

2. TAMS CENTER -  ITEP'S TAMS CENTER STAFF WILL PROVIDE ROBUST OUTREACH TO TRIBES TO HELP PROMOTE THE SERVICES OFFERED BY THE TAMS CENTER.   OUTREACH WILL INCLUDE BUT NOT LIMITED TO THE FOLLOWING:
- RECEIVING AND RESPONDING TO REQUESTS:  TAMS CENTER STAFF WILL RESPOND TO EMAIL, PHONE CALLS AND OTHER FORMS OF INQUIRY SUBMITTED BY TRIBES IN A TIMELY AND PROFESSIONAL MANNER.  INQUIRIES ARE LOGGED AND TRACKED IN ITEP'S INQUIRY TRACKING DATABASE AND REPORTED TO EPA IN QUARTERLY REPORTS.   
- TAMS CENTER CLEARINGHOUSE:  ITEP WILL MAINTAIN AND UPDATE A LIBRARY OF RESOURCES (DETAILED IN TASK 3) THAT IS AVAILABLE ONLINE TO AID TRIBES WITH SAMPLE DOCUMENTS, TECHNICAL MANUALS, AND OTHER USEFUL RESOURCES.   
-TAMS LISTSERV:  ITEP HAS DEVELOPED AND WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A TAMS LISTSERV.  THIS LISTSERV OF TRIBAL PROFESSIONALS THAT HAVE ATTENDED TAMS TRAININGS AND IS POPULATED WITH OVER 250 CONTACTS.  
ITEP WILL CONDUCT TWO IN-PERSON TAMS STEERING COMMITTEE MEETINGS ANNUALLY. ONE MEETING WILL TAKE PLACE IN FIRST QUARTER OF THE PROJECT, AND ONE WILL TAKE PLACE IN THE SECOND QUARTER ANNUALLY.  MEETINGS WILL BE LOCATED AT THE TAMS CENTER FACILITIES, TO REDUCE TRAVEL EXPENSES FOR TAMS CENTER AND EPA ON-SITE STAFF.  FUNDING IS BUDGETED TO COVER TRAVEL EXPENSES FOR THE SEVEN (7) ELECTED MEMBERS OF THE TAMS STEERING COMMITTEE.  ITEP STAFF WILL WORK CLOSELY WITH EPA STAFF AND STEERING COMMITTEE REPRESENTATIVES TO PLAN EACH MEETING AND ITS AGENDA. PLANNING OF THE AGENDA FOR THE IN-PERSON MEETINGS WILL OCCUR DURING BI-MONTHLY CALLS WITH THE TAMS STEERING COMMITTEE AND WITH TAMS SENIOR MANAGERS. FOLLOWING THE STEERING COMMITTEE MEETINGS, A SUMMARY OF MEETING OUTCOMES AND ACTION ITEMS IS PROVIDED TO THE COMMITTEE. BI-MONTHLY VIRTUAL MEETINGS ARE ALSO CONVENED WITH COMMITTEE MEMBERS TO ENSURE ADEQUATE PROGRESS ON ACTION ITEMS IS MADE, AS WELL AS TO ADDRESS NEW OR EMERGING ISSUES IDENTIFIED BY TRIBES AND EPA.

3. PROFESSIONAL ASSISTANCE - ITEP'S EXISTING WEBSITE (HTTP://WWW7.NAU.EDU/ITEP/MAIN/AIR/) IS DESIGNED TO SUPPORT ALL AIAQTP ACTIVITIES AND TASKS UNDER THIS AGREEMENT. THIS ROBUST AND DYNAMIC WEBSITE PROVIDES EASY ACCESS TO INFORMATION ON AIR QUALITY TRAINING, INCLUDING: SCHEDULES, COURSE DESCRIPTIONS, PRE-REQUISITES, AND APPLICATION MATERIALS. ONLINE REGISTRATION IS CURRENTLY OFFERED FOR ITEP WORKSHOPS AND THE NTFAQ CONFERENCE. THIS WEBSITE IS ALSO A PORTAL TO THE TAMS CENTER WEBSITE (HTTP://WWW7.NAU.EDU/ITEP/MAIN/TAMS) WHERE A LIBRARY OF TECHNICAL RESOURCES, VIDEOS, TUTORIALS AND DOCUMENTS ARE HOUSED TO SUPPORT TRIBAL AIR QUALITY PROGRAMS.  RECORDED WEBINARS AND PRESENTATIONS ARE MAINTAINED ON ITEP'S MEDIASPACE CHANNEL: HTTPS://MEDIASPACE.NAU.EDU/CATEGORY/ITEP/68880892. WEBSITE CONTENT IS UPDATED ON A QUARTERL

CCA WILL ACCELERATE ACCESS TO CLEAN COOKING THROUGH STANDARDSBASED NATIONAL POLICIES AND COUNTRY-LEVEL CLIMATE ACTION, RESULTING IN INCREASED AWARENESS, CAPACITY AND ACTION TO INCREASE THE SUSTAINED USE OF CLEAN FUELS AND TECHNOLOGIES, AND EMISSIONS REDUCTIONS IN LMICS FROM HOUSEHOLD ENERGY USE. THROUGH THE PROPOSED ACTIVITIES, CCA INTENDS TO ADVANCE THE STATE OF KNOWLEDGE; INCREASE THE EXCHANGE OF TECHNICAL AND PROGRAMMATIC ADVANCES; AND ACHIEVE RESULTS THAT RAPIDLY INCREASE THE USE OF CLEAN, RELIABLE, AFFORDABLE, EFFICIENT, AND SAFE HOME COOKING AND HEATING PRACTICES.ACTIVITIES:CCA INTENDS TO ADVANCE THE STATE OF KNOWLEDGE; INCREASE THE EXCHANGE OF TECHNICAL AND PROGRAMMATIC ADVANCES; AND ACHIEVE RESULTS THAT RAPIDLY INCREASE THE USE OF CLEAN, RELIABLE, AFFORDABLE, EFFICIENT, AND SAFE HOME COOKING AND HEATING PRACTICES.

STANDARDS:
UNDER THE PROJECT PROPOSED HERE, CCA WILL UNDERTAKE A THREE-PRONGED APPROACH TO STANDARDS AND TESTING: (1) SUPPORT POLICYMAKERS AND OTHER RELEVANT STAKEHOLDERS IN THEIR EFFORTS TO IMPLEMENT STANDARDS TO ACHIEVE POLICY GOALS, INCLUDING HOW TO ADOPT/ADAPT ISO STANDARDS AT THE NATIONAL LEVEL; (2) STRENGTHEN CAPACITY OF REGIONAL TESTING AND KNOWLEDGE CENTERS (RTKCS) USING THE PUBLISHED ISO CLEAN COOKING STANDARDS TESTING PROTOCOLS AND REPORTING FRAMEWORKS, AS WELL AS THE DEMAND FOR THESE SERVICES; AND (3) STRENGTHEN THE ISO STANDARDS THEMSELVES.

STANDARDS IMPLEMENTATION:
CCA PROPOSES TO HOLD TWO IN-PERSON REGIONAL STANDARDS IMPLEMENTATION WORKSHOPS WITH THE THIRD COHORT IN DAKAR, SENEGAL, AND THE FOURTH COHORT IN LA PAZ, BOLIVIA, TO HELP GOVERNMENT STAKEHOLDERS ADAPT/ADOPT THE ISO CCA/C-CHEER PROJECT NARRATIVE 3 STANDARDS INTO NATIONAL POLICY AND IMPLEMENT THEM. THESE TWO WORKSHOPS WILL HAVE THE ADVANTAGE OF BUILDING ON A STRONG FOUNDATION OF KNOWLEDGE AND PLANNING EXECUTED DURING THE VIRTUAL CONVENINGS.

CCA FURTHER PROPOSES TO UNDERTAKE AN ASSESSMENT OF WHICH COUNTRIES HAVE ADOPTED THE ISO STANDARDS, ALONG WITH THE DETAILS OF ANY ADAPTATIONS TO THEM, AND INFORMATION ON THEIR USE OF REPORTING TIERS. TO DATE, THIS INFORMATION HAS BEEN DIFFICULT TO ACCESS. CCA PROPOSES TO WORK WITH WHO TO INCLUDE THIS INFORMATION IN THE WHO ENERGY POLICY REPOSITORY, RATHER THAN MAINTAINING IT IN A SEPARATE DATABASE.

ONE IMPORTANT POSSIBLE ASPECT OF STANDARDS IMPLEMENTATION IS LABELING. WITH SEPARATE FUNDING, CCA IS CURRENTLY UNDERTAKING RESEARCH IN KENYA TO DETERMINE THE EFFECTIVENESS OF KENYA'S PROPOSED COOKSTOVE LABELING SCHEME TO INFLUENCE CUSTOMER PURCHASING. CCA WILL APPLY THE OUTCOMES OF THIS RESEARCH, WHICH WILL BE COMPLETED IN MID-2023, TO IDENTIFY WHERE LABELING PROGRAMS COULD HELP INCREASE DEMAND FOR HIGH-QUALITY, CLEANER, AND MORE EFFICIENT COOKING TECHNOLOGIES AND FUELS, AND TO PROVIDE APPROPRIATE TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE ON LABELING IN 2-3 COUNTRIES. COUNTRIES TO BE EVALUATED FOR THIS SUPPORT WILL INCLUDE THOSE RECEIVING STANDARDS IMPLEMENTATION DEEP-DIVE SUPPORT, THOSE IDENTIFIED BY CCA'S USER INSIGHTS LAB (WHICH WILL ALSO PROVIDE INSIGHTS ON SOCIAL AND CULTURAL PRACTICES TO PROMOTE ADOPTION OF NEW TECHNOLOGY AND TRACKING SOCIOECONOMIC IMPACTS), AND COUNTRIES PARTICIPATING IN CCA'S DELIVERY UNIT NETWORK.

TESTING:
